Mette Hedelund is a quality consultant at the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) and the official contact person for the national ADHD database [^src1]. In this capacity, she serves as the primary administrative and operational point of contact for users of the database [^src1]. Her direct phone number and email address are listed in the database's reporting documentation to facilitate stakeholder communication [^src1]. 

Her role is situated within the context of the ADHD database's 2024 annual report, which marks a historic expansion to include the first complete measurement of ADHD treatment quality in Denmark—covering children, youth, adults, and both public and private actors. While the broader report evaluates the healthcare system's ability to meet national quality indicators and identifies structural barriers like IT deficits and staffing shortages, Hedelund's specific function is to act as the operational bridge for professionals interacting with this expanded measurement system. Beyond her designation as the official contact person and her provided contact details, no further biographical or professional claims are documented in the available data.
